game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge, a ridge known for yetis: the ice axe ranger must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Checkpoint: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values.
theme: Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge: a ridge known for yetis
core_gameplay_loop: In Yeti Ridge, repeat each round: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values. Each round, crevasse ghouls strike the ice ladder, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the checkpoint value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the ice ladder from crevasse ghouls in Yeti Ridge: keep the checkpoint meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: checkpoint drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Key Checkpoint
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Checkpoint' (Week 8 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Yeti Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how checkpoint changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Yeti Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while checkpoint > 0.
